title: Bare or malformed standard citations (documentation-§6)
cluster_summary: These are leftovers from earlier citation sweeps, so each fix belongs in the repo that has it. No upstream fix makes them unnecessary, and a per-addon guard test is the wrong tool because it would reject the continuation form the standard uses itself ('debug-logging-§8/§9'). One item must be fixed: MultiMeters has a malformed '(architecture-4)', which breaks the MUST grade, and correcting it is a one-character comment edit. The other work is optional polish. KickCD has standalone bare §N sites in its tests and live docs. LibKa0s has a payload file:line citation, which should ride the next Slash.lua change (#43) and not justify a release of its own. The ConsumableMaster finding is refuted because its sites are continuations of the same kind the standard writes. The PartyFrameEnhanced finding is an observation and needs no work.

verdicts.assessment: I checked all three sites. Each continues a qualified citation in the same parenthetical, for example '(debug-logging-§8's deferred work, §9's quiet steady state)' and '(debug-logging-§8/§9, DL-CM-02)'. They resolve at once, and the standard uses the same form itself.

The sites exist. Several test_flow_traces.lua sites (:216, :258, :318) read '-- §8 diagnosis:' far from any qualifying header, and the live-doc sites use a bare §7 or §14. The governing rule is documentation-§6 (SHOULD), not documentation-§5 or the index (MUST). Each site resolves from context earlier in the file, so the fix is polish only.
verdicts.remediation: Qualify the standalone sites, all in one KickCD comment and doc commit. In tests/test_flow_traces.lua and tests/test_library_lines.lua:97 use debug-logging-§8/§9. Use options-ui-§7 at docs/settings-panel.md:62, options-ui-§14 at :203, and slash-commands-§7 at docs/slash-dispatch.md:70 and :97. Leave adjacent continuations as they are, for example slash-dispatch.md:117. Do not add the test_source_style guard.

verdicts.assessment: core/LifecycleSetup.lua:117 reads '(architecture-4)'. That does not parse as filename-§N, so it is malformed, which documentation-§6 grades MUST. The fix is trivial and comment-only, and the target is architecture-§4 (Closed message bus).
verdicts.remediation: Change '(architecture-4)' to '(architecture-§4)' at core/LifecycleSetup.lua:117. It can ride any MultiMeters commit in this run.

verdicts.assessment: This is an observation with no defect. Every hit cites the addon's own design and test-mode specs, which documentation-§6 does not govern, and none is malformed or out of range.

The file is LibKa0s/LibKa0s/Slash.lua:267, not LibKa0s/Slash.lua. It reads '(slash-commands.md:34)', which still resolves to slash-commands-§1 but will drift on the next reflow. Because the comment is in the payload, fixing it needs a Slash MINOR bump and a re-vendor. That much churn for one comment is not justified on its own, so the #43 deferral stands.
verdicts.remediation: If this run already changes LibKa0s/LibKa0s/Slash.lua or bumps Slash, change the comment to '(slash-commands-§1)' with Slash MINOR 19 -> 20 and close #43 as state:done in that change. Otherwise keep #43 triaged. Do not cut a release just for this comment.
